description:
Verifies the measured holdout confirmation of the calibrated decode profile and records its outcome as evaluated.

## Background

The confirmation addendum of the decode selector holdout family is frozen with its holdout cells and committed under `dev/active/ed3d490e-zen3-ldpc-frame-simd/`; the benchmark window runs the queued confirmation of the tuned-portable arm, which installs the committed coding envelope, against the conservative-portable arm. Every timed run is one line of `dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/bench-window/queue.tsv`, executed in the overnight benchmark window; nothing timed runs in a working session. The [Zen 3 measurement contract](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md), the [frozen protocol](../f547c394/protocol.md) with its [version-4 amendment](../f547c394/amendment-v4.md) and the [worker brief](../1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/worker-brief.md) govern every cell.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each confirmation campaign is verified from its own append-only execution log with the shared campaign-log verifier, at the protocol's confirmatory pair count on fresh samples.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each receipt is committed with its input snapshots, and the `benchmark-acceptance` verdict recomputed from the committed receipt reproduces the committed acceptance summary byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: Each cell's decision and outcome are recorded as the evaluator records them, including fail, not-material, regressed, inconclusive and not-confirmatory; no margin is revised and no further attempt is queued after a non-passing outcome.
- [hard] REQ-04: The outcome states, per holdout cell, whether the calibrated profile holds on inputs the calibration did not use, and the conservative-portable, tuned-portable and native results stay separate.
- [hard] REQ-05: If the profile does not qualify, the committed envelope is recorded as not adopted and the conservative selectors remain the production values.
title: Collect the decode selector holdout confirmation
